hintSettingsHandleSide:
Where the settings handle is shown: on the left side of the map, on the right side, or not at all.

The settings handle opens the drawer selection.
hintSelectDrawers:
Add, remove, or rearrange drawer items on the left and right sides of the map.

Drag an item between the sections to move it: to the left side, to the right side, or to the available section.
hintSortableHandle: When enabled, drawer handles can be reordered by dragging. When disabled, the order is locked but handles can still be tapped.
